title: Cached unit inversion condition
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient Λ, scheme Y, module-object family L, shifted second-projection line comparison e, and object M on the projective line, UnitInversionCondition(Λ,Y,L,e,M) means exactly that the canonical ambient exchange at M and the twisted projection at the first pullback of M are both invertible. The fixed maps and categories are those of [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites], [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback], [def-sfb-tate-twisted-projection-comparison].

proof.text: Define the condition to be the conjunction of IsIso for the fixed exchange and for the fixed twisted projection, with exactly the arguments in unitInversions. This only names an existing proposition; no invertibility fact is assumed or proved. The generic definition caches all category-instance expressions before concrete specialization. Unfolding it recovers the original condition verbatim.

proof_origin.place: C1 definitional naming of the existing inversion condition for kernel-efficient specialization

def UnitInversionCondition (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X)
    (e : (moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (secondProjection Y)).obj
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).obj
        (L (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
        (L (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) : Prop
